title: REAL ID - what it does not change
facts: REAL ID requirements concern specified federal identification uses, not whether a person may legally drive under state law.
A non-REAL-ID state driver's license may still be valid for driving if valid under state law, even if it is not accepted for a covered federal identification purpose.

REAL ID is not required for voting, applying for or receiving federal benefits, accessing health services, participating in law-enforcement proceedings, or other activities not designated by the REAL ID Act.
State DMV documentation requirements for obtaining REAL ID vary within the federal framework.
